source.author: verg
source.text: Illi indignantes magno cum murmure montis circum claustra fremunt; celsa sedet Aeolus arce sceptra tenens, mollitque animos et temperat iras.
source.text_original: Illi indignantes magno cum murmure montis / circum claustra fremunt; celsa sedet Aeolus arce / sceptra tenens, mollitque animos et temperat iras.
source.text_english: There they, in anger, with a great murmur of the mountain, rage around the barriers; Aeolus sits on his high citadel, holding his sceptre, and softens their spirits and tempers their anger.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Interea medio saevus permissa profundo carbasa Pangaea Boreas speculatus ab arce continuo Aeoliam Tyrrhenaque tendit ad antra concitus.
reuse.text_original: Interea medio saevus permissa profundo / carbasa Pangaea Boreas speculatus ab arce / continuo Aeoliam Tyrrhenaque tendit ad antra / concitus.
reuse.text_english: Meanwhile, from the Pangaean citadel, fierce Boreas, having surveyed the sails entrusted to the deep in mid-ocean, at once, roused, speeds toward Aeolia and the Tyrrhenian caves.
